rows.Kwic: 梁武帝請講金剛經，士纔陞座，以尺揮按一下，便下座，帝愕然。誌公曰：陛下會麼？帝曰：不會。誌公曰：大士講經竟。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Shanhui Dashi (善慧大士語錄): after Fu Dashi leaves the lecture seat, Baozhi asks Emperor Wu whether he understands and declares the great man's scripture lecture finished.
